# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V1020 recursive_lambda"
description: "Local lambdas cannot refer to themselves."
---

An error from the `resolve` phase. `sakura explain V1020` prints this explanation offline.

Local lambdas cannot refer to themselves. Lift the function to the top level, where functions
may be mutually recursive.

Wrong:

```sakura
let fact = fn(n) { if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) } }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int { if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) } }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V1020_recursive_lambda.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V1020_recursive_lambda.sakura), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn fact_of_five() -> Int {
  let fact = fn(n) { if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) } }
  fact(5)
}
```

## Fixed program
